current.text: He joined the Bucks from Miami as part of the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
The newest team preview has him as the backup center behind Myles Turner. The projected starters to open the season are Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
Taylor Jenkins is the new head coach. It is not clear yet whether he will give Ware a fantasy-friendly role or focus on winning, and he might use a deep rotation.

His role is unclear. If Jenkins names him a starter at center or power forward, he moves up to tier five or higher among centers. Experts expect him to play clearly more than 22 minutes, somewhere around 25 to 30.
Experts rank him around 60 to 80 in his current role. At about 29 to 30 minutes a night he would rank in the top 40s.
Experts expect managers to reach for him, possibly in the top 50. They also say he is not better than Turner yet, and his fit next to Turner is uncertain.
Of the players Milwaukee got from Miami, he is the least likely to be traded.
The speaker doubts his 40% three-point shooting will last.
His free throw percentage fell under 60% in the second half of last season.

durable.text: He is an elite rebounder with a high block rate, and he makes threes for a big.
He rarely passes. His assists are among the lowest in the top 200.
He is a fantasy beast per minute. He finished roughly 94th to 119th last season in only 22 minutes a night.
He is much better in category leagues than in points leagues.
He is horrible on defense and has plenty of lapses on both ends. His minutes in Miami were limited because of his play, not because of the coach.
Miami benched him for poor shot selection and team play, which caused problems with Erik Spoelstra.
One speaker says his off-court behavior was a distraction in Miami.
He is only 22 and his potential is sky high, so he could improve. He fits best at center.

note: Both sites value him at 13 USD, but average costs are only 3.8 to 4.1 USD and he went for 5 USD in our league last season. He looks like a good value bid up to about his 13 USD value: he helps REB, BLK and FG% at little cost, and no category is flagged weak, so the low assists hurt any build only a little. Early in the season, check whether Jenkins starts him or plays him 26 minutes or more, since that is the gap between a 70s to 80s rank and the top 40s. Also watch whether his three-point and free throw shooting hold up.
